banner: S-16006  -  billed 2.71 from a setting applied BY CLICKING the Locations dialog   (build v3.8-1f5fb3c)
caption:
The end-to-end path an end user takes: "Invoice total" chosen in the Locations dialog by clicking, saved with the
Save button, then a work order invoiced. It bills $2.71 - the invoice-total figure. The same three lines under the
default bill $2.70, so this proves the setting a user saves from the screen is the one that reaches the invoice.

banner: Reached by clicking "Receive" on the Parts > Purchase Orders list   ->   /order/{poId}?receive=1

boxes.label: the receive form a user actually gets
this saves via receive-requested-parts, and it works

caption:
Where a user ends up when they click Receive. All 30 Receive links on the Purchase Orders list point at this same
screen, and the part row on a work order leads here too - both routes save through receive-requested-parts and
both work. Parts > Vendor Invoices rows open a read-only view with no receive action, so there is no click-path
to the older /accept-delivery screen whose save fails.
